title: Radius model validated: R = 2*sqrt(1 - 0.6 K^2/N)
interpretation: the surface term (K^2/N scale) removes ~0.6*K^2/N of the spectral mass from the bulk edge: the support shrinks to R = 2*sqrt(1-0.6K^2/N). Both full-curve measurements fit; the N=53 point (K^2/N > 1) is outside the model's range as expected.
status: [NUMERICALLY-SUPPORTED] two-design fit; the coefficient 0.6 needs the analytic derivation
